Sudden insight models the non-deterministic leap in creativity. These operators are dual in nature—genetic convergence and inventive reiteration both describe recurrence under constraints, whereas sudden insight introduces non-linearity. Failure modes include misidentification of descent lines due to lack of proof, and over-reliance on perceived novelty in invention. The interplay between these operators suggests a probabilistic framework where evolutionary and inventive processes share structural similarities in terms of path selection and outcome emergence.
